description: Source code for FireCrawl document loader component, including class definitions, interfaces, and methods for crawling, scraping, extracting, and searching web content using FireCrawl API, integrated with langchain and other utilities.

classes.name: FirecrawlApp
classes.description: Class encapsulating API interactions for FireCrawl, including methods for scraping, crawling, extracting, and searching.

classes.name: FireCrawlLoader
classes.description: Class extending BaseDocumentLoader to load documents via FireCrawl API based on mode (crawl, scrape, extract, search).

classes.name: FireCrawl_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: Node class implementing INode, providing configuration and initialization for FireCrawl document loader node.

methods.name: scrapeUrl
methods.description: Method to scrape a URL with optional parameters, returning success status and data.

methods.name: crawlUrl
methods.description: Method to crawl a URL with optional parameters, optionally waiting for completion.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Method to extract data from URLs with optional parameters, optionally waiting for completion.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Method to perform web search with query and parameters.

methods.name: prepareHeaders
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers including authorization and optional idempotency key.

methods.name: postRequest
methods.description: Performs POST request to specified URL with data and headers.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Performs GET request to specified URL with headers.

methods.name: monitorJobStatus
methods.description: Polls and monitors the status of a crawl job until completion or failure.

methods.name: monitorExtractStatus
methods.description: Polls and monitors the status of an extract job until completion or failure.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors based on HTTP response status and data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Main method to load documents based on mode, converting API responses into langchain Document instances.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, credentials, and parameters, then loads documents accordingly.
